task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's coverage (commit 28808b73). Independently verify every acceptance criterion has a runnable test, no skipped coverage, isolated self-sufficient fixtures. Per WF-03_issue_resolving.md's fail-then-pass section: this is a fix to EXISTING behavior, not a new module, so you must not accept the reported fail-then-pass proof on trust -- independently re-run AT LEAST the :assertion_run_missing test (ISS-0732's own headline symptom) against pre-fix code yourself (a throwaway git worktree of main, same technique TEST-DESIGNER used) and confirm it fails with the reported fail-mode, then confirm it passes on this branch. Also read all 3 new gate-path tests plus the 2 OQ-2 amendment tests directly to confirm each asserts something concrete (a specific error reason, a specific HTTP status, that nothing was written on the rejection paths) rather than a loose/weak assertion.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 new tests (3 original gate paths + 2 OQ-2 amendment paths) read directly and confirmed to assert concrete, specific outcomes
At least the :assertion_run_missing test independently re-run against a throwaway worktree of main by YOU, confirmed to fail with the reported fail-mode, and confirmed to pass on this branch
No existing test's assertion confirmed weakened (diff-check against main)
Any throwaway worktree used is removed and its removal verified before completing this handoff
